scheduleSource.note:
IMPORTANT INFRASTRUCTURE FINDING even though the schedule itself is currently missing. sport.ujbuda.hu is a Vite/React SPA and serves NO server-rendered HTML (curl returns a 2 KB JS shell), so plain scraping of the public URL yields nothing. The real content is available as JSON from the Újbuda CMS API at https://api.ujbuda.hu/webapi/v1.0/static-pages/156 — but ONLY if you send the header 'Domain: sport.ujbuda.hu'; without it the API returns {"error":{"code":10002,"message":"Invalid domain"}}. The numeric id 156 comes from https://api.ujbuda.hu/webapi/v1.0/sitemap (same Domain header), where the node with slug 'nyekiimreuszoda' carries id 156 — resolve it there rather than hardcoding. The JSON's .content field is an HTML blob. It contains a real for the vízigimnasztika timetable (columns: óra | Hétfő | Kedd | Szerda | Csütörtök | Péntek | Szombat | Vasárnap; rows 7.00-8.00, 9.00-10.00, 14.00-15.00, 19.00-20.00; cells marked 'x'). It also contains the lane-occupancy section headed 'A PÁLYAFOGLALTSÁGGAL kapcsolatos információk. A kékkel jelölt rubrikák jelzik medencéink foglalt sávjait.' with three labelled slots in this order: 'Tanmedence:', 'Nagymedence kint:', 'Nagymedence bent:'. AS OF 2026-09-24 THOSE THREE SLOTS ARE EMPTY — the markup after each label is only
whitespace; the grids that normally sit there have been taken down. The three tags still present in the blob are NOT schedules: e4a7b87f-....jpg was downloaded and visually checked and is a Star Sport Akadémia advertisement, e686f6ed-....jpg belongs to the 'Kistornaterem órarendje' gym section, and 68255200-....jpg could not be downloaded (repeated curl timeouts against api.ujbuda.hu file storage) so its content is unverified. Worth re-polling: when the operator re-uploads, blue-shaded cells = occupied lanes, and the section covers all three basins.

notes: COORDINATE VERIFIED: Nominatim and Overpass independently return a sports_centre named 'Nyéki Imre Uszoda' at 47.4503, 19.0363 tagged addr 1116 Kondorosi út 14, and the operator's own CMS content states 'Budapest - XI. kerület, Kondorosi út 14.' — match. (Two nearby OSM bus-stop nodes share the name; they were discarded.) BASIN NAMES are taken verbatim from the operator's own lane-occupancy section, which is the only official enumeration: Tanmedence, Nagymedence kint, Nagymedence bent. LANE COUNTS AND LENGTHS ARE NULL ON PURPOSE — no official source states either. Secondary/aggregator sources claim a 33 m indoor pool, an '8-sávos' tanmedence, and a 25 m outdoor summer pool plus a children's pancsoló and jakuzzi, but none of that is confirmed by the operator, so it is recorded here as hearsay only and NOT in the basins array. OPENING HOURS GAP: the official page lists Hétfő/szerda 06:00-20:00, Kedd/csütörtök 06:00-19:00, Szombat/vasárnap 06:00-18:00 and SILENTLY OMITS FRIDAY. One secondary source claims Friday closes at 18:00, but this is unconfirmed, so no weekday-5 entry is emitted. The site is a SZÉP-kártya acceptance point and sells a 2-hour 'úszójegy'.
